season.sr: Radi otprilike od kraja marta do početka novembra; zimi je zatvoren, osim pojedinih prazničnih vikenda.

tagline.sr: Grad od kockica u kome i najmlađi prvi put voze auto i voz.
tagline.en: A town built of bricks, where even the youngest get their first drive.

description.sr: Legoland Bilund je originalni park od lego kockica, smešten tik uz fabriku u kojoj je Lego nastao. Najmlađi obožavaju Duplo zemlju, Miniland sa gradovima i lukama od miliona kockica i lagane vožnje koje mogu da voze i deca od dve-tri godine. Park je prostran, ravan i potpuno prilagođen kolicima, sa dosta senke i mirnih kutaka za hranjenje. Ovo je raj za decu od 2 do 6 godina i pravo mesto za prvo veliko tematsko iskustvo.
description.en: Legoland Billund is the original LEGO park, right next to the factory where LEGO began. Little ones love DUPLO Land, the Miniland cities and harbours built from millions of bricks, and the gentle rides that children as young as two can drive themselves. The park is spacious, flat and completely stroller-friendly, with plenty of shade and quiet corners for feeding. It is heaven for two-to-six-year-olds and the ideal first big theme-park trip.

description.sr: Diznilend Pariz je najbliža velika Diznijeva destinacija za porodice iz regiona, sa dva parka, paradama i likovima koje deca obožavaju. Za najmlađe su najlepši Fantazilend, Dumbo, karuseli i mali vozovi, dok roditelji cene što je sve ravno i prilagođeno kolicima. Uz dosta zatvorenih atrakcija, park dobro funkcioniše i po kiši i zimi. Cene su visoke, ali je iskustvo za decu od 3 do 6 godina čista magija.
description.en: Disneyland Paris is the closest major Disney destination for families in the region, with two parks, parades and the characters children adore. For the youngest, Fantasyland, Dumbo, the carousels and the little trains are the highlight, while parents appreciate how flat and stroller-friendly everything is. With plenty of indoor attractions, it works well in rain and winter too. Prices are high, but for three-to-six-year-olds the experience is pure magic.

tagline.sr: Park bajki u šumi — deca mlađa od četiri godine ulaze besplatno.
tagline.en: A fairytale park in the woods — under-fours go free.

description.sr: Efteling je jedan od najlepših tematskih parkova Evrope, smešten u šumi i prepun bajki koje oživljavaju na svakom koraku. Njegova Šuma bajki je čarobna i za decu od dve godine, a lagane vožnje poput čamčića i parnog voza nemaju visinskih ograničenja. Park je ravan, zelen i pun senke, pa je idealan za duge porodične dane. Uz besplatan ulaz za mlađe od četiri godine, odličan je izbor za prvi park van zemlje.
description.en: Efteling is one of Europe's most beautiful theme parks, set in woodland and full of fairy tales that come alive at every turn. Its Fairytale Forest is magical even for two-year-olds, and the gentle boat and steam-train rides have no height limits. The park is flat, green and full of shade, making it ideal for long family days. With free entry for under-fours, it is a superb first foreign theme park.

tagline.sr: Drugi najstariji zabavni park na svetu, u srcu Kopenhagena.
tagline.en: The world's second-oldest amusement park, in the heart of Copenhagen.

description.sr: Tivoli je šarmantni zabavni park u samom centru Kopenhagena, u kome su bašte, jezerce i svetla podjednako lepi kao i vožnje. Za najmlađe postoje mirne vožnje i karuseli, a šetnja kroz cvetne aleje je prijatna i sa kolicima. Ulaz je jeftiniji nego u velikim parkovima, a vožnje se plaćaju posebno, pa porodica može da bira koliko će se vozati. Božićna sezona sa svetlima i pijacama je posebno čarobna.
description.en: Tivoli is a charming amusement park right in central Copenhagen, where the gardens, the lake and the lights are as lovely as the rides. There are gentle rides and carousels for the youngest, and a stroll through the flower gardens is pleasant even with a pram. Entry is cheaper than at the big parks and rides are paid separately, so a family can choose how much to ride. The Christmas season with its lights and markets is especially magical.

tagline.en: Germany's biggest theme park, with a whole zone for the youngest.

description.sr: Evropa park je najveći i najposećeniji tematski park Nemačke, podeljen na tematske zemlje Evrope. Za porodice sa malom decom su najvažniji mirni kutci poput Zone bajki i vožnje bez visinskih ograničenja, dok starija braća i sestre mogu da uživaju u velikim toboganima. Park je besprekorno uređen, ravan i prilagođen kolicima, sa dosta zatvorenih atrakcija. Deca mlađa od četiri godine ulaze besplatno.
description.en: Europa-Park is Germany's biggest and most-visited theme park, divided into themed European lands. For families with small children the gentle corners matter most, like the Fairytale Zone and the rides with no height limits, while older siblings can enjoy the big coasters. The park is immaculately kept, flat and stroller-friendly, with plenty of indoor attractions. Children under four enter free.

tagline.sr: Ogromno igralište na otvorenom gde deca sama grade svet od Plejmobila.
tagline.en: A giant open-air playground where kids build their own PLAYMOBIL world.

description.sr: Plejmobil FunPark nije klasičan park sa vožnjama, već ogromno igralište podeljeno na tematske zone — gusarski brod, viteški dvorac, vodeni svet i kućice na drvetu. Deca se penju, prskaju, kopaju zlato i sama se igraju sa velikim Plejmobil figurama, pa je ovo raj za mališane od dve do sedam godina. Sve je ravno, bezbedno i prilagođeno kolicima, a ulaz je neuporedivo jeftiniji nego u velikim parkovima.
description.en: PLAYMOBIL FunPark is not a ride park but a giant playground divided into themed zones — a pirate ship, a knight's castle, a water world and treehouses. Children climb, splash, pan for gold and play freely with big PLAYMOBIL figures, making it heaven for two-to-seven-year-olds. Everything is flat, safe and stroller-friendly, and entry is far cheaper than at the big parks.

tagline.sr: Prvi 'geo-zoo' na svetu, uz reku Isar — jeftin i savršen za mališane.
tagline.en: The world's first 'geo-zoo' by the Isar river — cheap and perfect for little ones.

description.sr: Hellabrun je prostran zoološki vrt u Minhenu, uređen po geografskim zonama u prirodnom okruženju uz reku Isar. Životinje su blizu staza, a dečja farma sa kozama i ponijima je pravi hit za mališane. Ulaz je povoljan, a velika porodična karta za dva odrasla i svu decu košta svega 45 evra. Uz igrališta i senovite staze, odličan je za poludnevni izlet i po lošijem vremenu.
description.en: Hellabrunn is a spacious Munich zoo arranged in geographic zones in a natural setting along the Isar river. The animals are close to the paths, and the children's farm with goats and ponies is a real hit with little ones. Entry is cheap, and the large family ticket for two adults and all their children costs just €45. With playgrounds and shaded paths, it is a great half-day outing even in less-than-perfect weather.

description.sr: Park Paultons je porodični park na jugu Engleske, najpoznatiji po Peppa Pig svetu — zoni potpuno posvećenoj omiljenoj prasici. Sve vožnje su mirne i kratke, baš po meri dece od jedne do šest godina, a u parku ima i dinosaurusi i igrališta za mališane. Ulaz je besplatan za decu nižu od metar, što pokriva većinu dvogodišnjaka i trogodišnjaka. Idealno za prvi tematski park uz englesko leto.
description.en: Paultons Park is a family park in the south of England, best known for Peppa Pig World — a zone entirely dedicated to the beloved little pig. All the rides are gentle and short, made to measure for one-to-six-year-olds, and the park also has dinosaurs and toddler play areas. Entry is free for children under a metre tall, which covers most two- and three-year-olds. Ideal for a first theme park during an English summer.

tagline.sr: Šuma u kojoj majmuni slobodno hodaju među posetiocima.
tagline.en: A forest where monkeys roam freely among the visitors.

description.sr: Apenheul je jedinstven park primata u šumi kod Apeldorna, gde se neke vrste majmuna slobodno kreću među posetiocima, na dohvat ruke. Deca su oduševljena kada im lemur pređe preko staze ili im se veveričji majmun približi. Staze su šumske i blago neravne, ali park je mali i lako se obiđe za pola dana. Ulaz je povoljan, a deca mlađa od tri godine ulaze besplatno.
description.en: Apenheul is a unique primate park in a forest near Apeldoorn, where some monkey species roam freely among the visitors, within arm's reach. Children are thrilled when a lemur crosses the path or a squirrel monkey comes close. The paths are woodland and slightly uneven, but the park is small and easy to cover in half a day. Entry is cheap, and children under three enter free.

tagline.sr: Troptska plaža pod kupolom — leto u januaru, sat od Berlina.
tagline.en: A tropical beach under a dome — summer in January, an hour from Berlin.

description.sr: Tropska ostrva su ogromna tropska kupola sa peščanom plažom, lagunom, toboganima i pravom džunglom — sve zagrejano na prijatnih 26 stepeni tokom cele godine. Za porodice sa bebama i mališanima ovo je savršen zimski beg: plitka voda, toplota i puno prostora za igru. Na raspolaganju su porodične svlačionice, igraonica i dečji klub. Deca do treće godine ulaze besplatno.
description.en: Tropical Islands is a huge tropical dome with a sandy beach, a lagoon, water slides and a real jungle — all kept at a pleasant 26°C all year round. For families with babies and toddlers this is the perfect winter escape: shallow water, warmth and lots of room to play. Family changing rooms, a soft-play area and a kids' club are available. Children up to three years enter free.

tagline.sr: 'Vrt svetova' — zoo vrt i botanička bašta u jednom, blizu Brisela.
tagline.en: The 'Garden of the Worlds' — zoo and botanic garden in one, near Brussels.

description.sr: Pairi Daiza je višestruko nagrađivani park životinja i bašti, uređen po tematskim 'svetovima' od Azije do Afrike, smešten u staroj opatiji. Za porodice su najlepši pande, pingvini i ograđeni prostori gde deca mogu da hrane koze, uz vožnju parnim vozom kroz park. Staze su dobre, ali je park velik, pa računajte na dosta hodanja. Deca mlađa od tri godine ulaze besplatno.
description.en: Pairi Daiza is a multi-award-winning animal and garden park laid out as themed 'worlds' from Asia to Africa, set in an old abbey. Families love the pandas, the penguins and the petting areas where children feed the goats, plus a ride on the steam train. The paths are good but the park is large, so expect plenty of walking. Children under three enter free.

tagline.sr: Kuća Pipi Duge Čarape i voz kroz priče Astrid Lindgren.
tagline.en: Pippi Longstocking's house and a train ride through Astrid Lindgren's stories.

description.sr: Junibaken je muzej priča posvećen Astrid Lindgren, smešten na ostrvu Jurgorden u Stokholmu. Centralni doživljaj je vožnja 'vozom kroz priče' koji prolazi kroz scene iz njenih knjiga, dok deca najviše vole Vilu Vilekulu, pravu kuću Pipi Duge Čarape. Sve je unutra, toplo i prilagođeno kolicima, pa je savršeno za kišne i hladne dane. Deca mlađa od dve godine ulaze besplatno.
description.en: Junibacken is a story museum dedicated to Astrid Lindgren, on the island of Djurgården in Stockholm. The centrepiece is a 'story train' ride through scenes from her books, while children love Villa Villekulla, Pippi Longstocking's actual house. Everything is indoors, warm and stroller-friendly, making it perfect for rainy and cold days. Children under two enter free.

tagline.sr: Muminovo ostrvo — najnežniji tematski park Skandinavije.
tagline.en: The Moomin island — Scandinavia's gentlest theme park.

description.sr: Muminov svet je tematski park na ostrvu Kajlo kod Naantalija, u kome oživljavaju likovi iz knjiga Tove Janson — Mumin, Snorki, Mala Mi i ostali. Nema brzih vožnji ni buke; deca se igraju u pravom Muminovom plavom tornju, kupaju na steni i upoznaju likove u kostimima. Sve je mirno, bezbedno i po meri dece od dve do sedam godina. Deca mlađa od dve godine ulaze besplatno.
description.en: Moomin World is a theme park on Kailo island near Naantali, bringing Tove Jansson's characters to life — Moomin, Snorkmaiden, Little My and the rest. There are no fast rides or noise; children play in the real blue Moominhouse, paddle by the rocks and meet the costumed characters. Everything is calm, safe and sized for two-to-seven-year-olds. Children under two enter free.
